title: Irish Potatoes Gratin
description: A rich and creamy potato gratin dish with a nod to Irish cuisine, perfect for a comforting dinner.
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine 1 cup heavy cream, 1/2 cup shredded Gruyère cheese, and 2 tablespoons melted unsalted butter.
Bring the mixture to a simmer over medium heat, whisking constantly.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour.
In a greased 9x13-inch baking dish, arrange 1/3 of the sliced potatoes in an overlapping pattern.
Pour 1/3 of the cream mixture over the potatoes, then sprinkle with 1/3 of the remaining Gruyère cheese.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of cheese on top.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the potatoes are tender.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with chopped scallions, if desired.
Let the gratin rest for 10-15 minutes before serving.
